full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows two young men closely framed against a deep, almost featureless dark background. The figure on the left fills the foreground in profile, facing right. A plain dark brimmed hat casts shade over his forehead, and the narrow bridge of the nose, closed lips, and rounded jaw are outlined by soft gray light. His dark jacket rises to the lower edge and merges into the black background. The second figure stands immediately behind and to the right, facing the camera directly. Thick wavy hair lifts over the forehead and catches a silvery highlight; one eye is sharply visible under the brow, while the other is partly shaded by the first man's hat and head. His expression is steady and serious, with relaxed closed lips and no theatrical gesture. He wears a dark high-collared coat that encloses the lower right of the frame. The two heads nearly touch, creating a narrow wedge of shadow between the side profile and the frontal face. The left profile is lit from the right side of the picture and becomes a pale plane against dark cloth; the right face receives a slightly brighter, more frontal light, which reveals eye, cheek, nose, and lip with fine tonal gradations. Shadows remain rich and velvety rather than uniformly flat. There is subtle photographic grain and soft edge falloff, but the eyes and profiles are clear. The crop reaches the top of the hat and hair and ends at the shoulders, leaving no room for a recognizable setting. Black clothing occupies much of the lower half, anchoring the pale faces within a compact arrangement. The photograph's close spacing, opposing head directions, and restrained grayscale make the two figures feel intimate and enigmatic without any implied action beyond their shared pose.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白照片将两名年轻男子紧紧框在深暗、几乎没有细节的背景前。左侧人物占据前景，侧身朝右。素净深色有檐帽给额头投下阴影，狭长鼻梁、闭合的嘴和圆润下颌被柔灰光勾出。他的深色外套伸到画面下沿，融入黑背景。第二人紧贴在其后偏右，直接面向相机。浓密波浪发从额头上扬并接住银灰高光；一只眼在眉下清晰可见，另一只部分被前一人的帽与头遮住。他神情平稳严肃，嘴唇放松闭合，没有夸张姿势。他穿深色高领外套，围住画面右下部。两颗头几乎相触，在侧面与正面之间形成狭窄阴影楔形。左侧面受到画面右方来的光，成为暗衣前的一块浅平面；右侧面容获得稍亮、较正面的光，以细腻灰阶显示眼、颊、鼻与嘴。阴影浓厚如绒，却并非均匀平黑。画面有轻微摄影颗粒与柔和边缘衰减，但眼睛和侧面轮廓都清楚。裁切上端到帽与发，下端到肩，没有留下可辨场景的空间。黑衣占据下半幅大部，将浅色面孔锚在紧凑排列里。照片中贴近的距离、相对的头部方向和克制灰阶使两人显得亲密而难解，却没有暗示共同摆姿之外的动作。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses a close crop and velvet-dark background to intensify a compact arrangement of overlapping forms. Soft directional light lifts selected pale planes from deep black and shadow, preserving finely graded midtones instead of stark cutout contrast. One contour reads as a clean side edge while another receives more frontal modeling, producing depth within very little space. Subtle grain and gentle falloff soften peripheral areas, yet focal edges remain clear. Large black fields anchor the lower composition and narrow shadow seams separate the lit forms. The mood is quiet and intimate, built from measured grayscale, restrained highlights, and close spatial compression.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影用贴近裁切与绒般深暗背景强化紧凑的交叠形态。柔和定向光把选定浅色平面从深黑与阴影中抬出，保留细密渐层中间调，而非生硬剪纸对比。一处轮廓形成清楚侧边，另一处得到更正面的塑形，使极小空间里也有纵深。细微颗粒与温和亮度衰减软化外围，但焦点边缘仍清楚。大片黑色锚住构图下方，窄阴影接缝分隔受光形态。气息安静而亲密，由节制灰阶、克制高光和近距离空间压缩构成。
theme_en: Two young men close together in a black-and-white studio portrait
theme_zh: 两名年轻男子紧靠在一张黑白影棚肖像里
name: Bruce Weber
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
